verdict.rationale: Netlify's docs say the official CLI can 'run local dev servers' (netlify-docs-15, netlify-probe-3), and a community user confirms Netlify Dev exists while reporting a configuration error with unclear netlify.toml [dev] docs (netlify-comm-12). The evidence only establishes a local dev server, not a simulator matching the production runtime. missing for 10: evidence of production-runtime parity (local emulation of serverless/edge functions, env vars, redirects), in-depth first-party docs on local testing, and positive independent corroboration of local-to-production fidelity.
